title: Portable local-model manifest, version 1
description: Data-only metadata written BESIDE a model's weights as .local-model-manifest.json. Consumers MUST treat an instance as untrusted data: parse it as strict JSON, never source, import, evaluate or execute it. See docs/model-manifest-v1.md.

schema_version.description: Exactly 1 for this schema. A consumer that does not recognise the value MUST refuse the file rather than guess at its shape.

kind.description: What the artifact IS. Independent of whether it can be launched.

launchable.description: Whether this artifact can be served as an independent endpoint. Deliberately separate from kind: a draft_model is a real artifact that must never be launched on its own, and a tts_model may be launchable while still not being a Claude Code session model.

session_eligible.description: Whether this artifact may be offered as a Claude Code SESSION model. Narrower than launchable: an mlx_lm-served text model is launchable for dispatch yet has no Anthropic /v1/messages surface, so it cannot drive a session.

directory_name.description: The artifact's own directory name, NEVER an absolute path. Consumers derive the path from the directory they are scanning, which is what makes the manifest portable across machines and users.

revision.description: The PINNED revision actually acquired. A branch name is not a revision.

payload_bytes.description: Measured on disk, never estimated. 0 is only valid for a non-payload entry.

target_directory_name.description: REQUIRED when kind is draft_model: the directory_name of the target model this drafter speculates for. Validation must confirm the target exists and is compatible.

alias_of_directory_name.description: For an override/alias entry that resolves to another installed artifact. Context is inherited from the target unless explicitly restated.

extended_context_tokens.description: Only reachable with an explicit, runtime-supported RoPE/YaRN configuration. Never enabled automatically, and never a substitute for a smaller live server limit.

context_source.description: Where the winning value was read from, so a reviewer can re-derive it.

context_candidates.description: EVERY plausible value discovered, retained even when they disagree. A conflict is resolved explicitly and with a reason, never by silently taking the largest.

context_conflict_resolution.description: REQUIRED when context_candidates disagree: which candidate won and why. Absent it, a validator must fail closed.

context_floor_100k_tokens.description: DERIVED, not independently maintained: (effective_context_tokens // 100000) * 100000. Persisted only for portability; a validator MUST recompute and compare.

claude_autocompact_tokens.description: DERIVED: null when the 100K floor is below 100000, otherwise min(1000000, floor). Claude Code accepts autocompaction only in 100000-token increments, minimum 100000, maximum 1000000.

profiles.description: One entry per ALIAS that shares this one physical directory. Aliases are grouped here rather than duplicated as separate artifact records.

qualification.description: tested = exercised on this machine with recorded evidence. untested = registered but unqualified. Never infer tested from a successful launch alone.

runtime_qualification.description: What was actually MEASURED, as opposed to what the architecture declares. An architectural maximum is not a tested safe limit.

server_context_tokens.description: What the LIVE server was actually allocated. A theoretical extended context must never override a smaller value here.

evidence.description: How the value was established, in enough detail to re-run. A number with no evidence is a guess.

status.description: complete ONLY after payload verification. A metadata-only shell must never claim complete.

catalogue_provenance.description: When a reviewed catalogue seeded any field, name it here so the manifest is not mistaken for pure artifact evidence.

contextTokens.description: A plausible context length. The lower bound rejects nonsense; the upper bound is set by the largest audited artifact (Llama 4 Scout, 10485760) and must not be tightened below it. Tokenizer sentinel values are rejected by the extractor even when numerically inside this range.

allOf.$comment: A draft_model must name its target and must not be independently launchable.
Non-model kinds are never Claude Code session models.
